VERSION 3.27.3.0

AFFECT [[2328484894988065446]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                visible: false
                source: "file:///home/root/drive-cloud/ui/CloudPage.qml"
                onLoaded: item.probe = true
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[12599552112012170435]]
    TRAVERSE ?#[[7713561876955258]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: driveCloudPage
                anchors.fill: payloadLoader
                active: settings._selectedIndex === SettingsPage.Cloud
                visible: active
                source: "file:///home/root/drive-cloud/ui/CloudPage.qml"
                Component.onCompleted: payloadLoader.visible = Qt.binding(function() { return !driveCloudPage.active; })
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
